facts: Result: Old Lions won by 34 runs
Toss: Old Lions won the toss and batted
Innings: Kensington Ridge CC 234 all out (46.3 overs)
Batting: Thabo Mokoena 112 off 118 balls (11 fours, 3 sixes)
Batting: Sipho Ndlovu 47 off 52 balls (6 fours)
Batting: Aiden Naidoo 31* off 22 balls (2 fours, 2 sixes)
Bowling: Musa Khumalo 4 for 38 off 9.3 overs
Bowling: Liam Botha 2 for 44 off 10 overs
Player of the match: Thabo Mokoena (112 off 118 balls (11 fours, 3 sixes))

captions.facebook: Old Lions 1st XI got the job done at home on Saturday, beating Kensington Ridge CC by 34 runs in Round 4 of the Premier League. Our Player of the Match is Thabo Mokoena, whose 112 off 118 balls (11 fours, 3 sixes) set up our 268/7. Sipho Ndlovu chipped in 47, Aiden Naidoo smashed 31* off just 22 balls, and Musa Khumalo led the attack with 4 for 38, with Liam Botha adding 2 for 44. Credit to Kensington Ridge for a good fight, they were all out for 234 in the 47th over. 🦁
